R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}_{2}(\nu)\right\|d\nu\in\mathbb{R},\quad t\in[\xi,T].

(B.85)

Then,

\displaystyle\left|N(t)\right|\leq\int_{\xi}^{t}e^{2(\theta_{1}-\theta_{2})\nu}\left\|\mathchoice{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\displaystyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\textstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.84808pt}{3.12502pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.12645pt}{2.70836pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptscriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}_{1}(\nu)\right\|\left\|R(\nu)\right\|_{F}\left\|\mathchoice{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\displaystyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\textstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.84808pt}{3.12502pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.12645pt}{2.70836pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptscriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}_{2}(\nu)\right\|d\nu\leq

\displaystyle\Delta_{R}\int_{\xi}^{t}e^{2(\theta_{1}-\theta_{2})\nu}\left\|\mathchoice{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\displaystyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\textstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.84808pt}{3.12502pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.12645pt}{2.70836pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptscriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}_{1}(\nu)\right\|\left\|\mathchoice{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\displaystyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\textstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.84808pt}{3.12502pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.12645pt}{2.70836pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptscriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}_{2}(\nu)\right\|d\nu

\displaystyle=

\displaystyle\Delta_{R}\mathchoice{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{7.3pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\displaystyle N\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{7.3pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\textstyle N\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{5.6678pt}{3.12502pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptstyle N\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.73894pt}{2.70836pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptscriptstyle N\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}(t),

and thus

\left\|N(t)\right\|_{L_{{\mathsf{p}}}}\leq\Delta_{R}\left\|\mathchoice{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{7.3pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\displaystyle N\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{7.3pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\textstyle N\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{5.6678pt}{3.12502pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptstyle N\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.73894pt}{2.70836pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptscriptstyle N\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}(t)\right\|_{L_{{\mathsf{p}}}},\quad\forall(t,{\mathsf{p}})\in[\xi,T]\times\mathbb{N}_{\geq 1}.

(B.86)

By following the same line of reasoning that led to (
B.11
) in the proof of Proposition
B.2
, we obtain:

\displaystyle\left\|\mathchoice{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{7.3pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\displaystyle N\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{7.3pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\textstyle N\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{5.6678pt}{3.12502pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptstyle N\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.73894pt}{2.70836pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptscriptstyle N\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}(t)\right\|_{L_{{\mathsf{p}}}}\leq\int_{\xi}^{t}e^{2\left(\theta_{1}-\theta_{2}\right)\nu}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathchoice{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\displaystyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\textstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.84808pt}{3.12502pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern (B.111)

Now, it follows from the definition of
\mathchoice{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\displaystyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\textstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.84808pt}{3.12502pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.12645pt}{2.70836pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptscriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}_{i}
,
i\in\left\{1,2\right\}
, that

\displaystyle\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathchoice{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\displaystyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\textstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.84808pt}{3.12502pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.12645pt}{2.70836pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptscriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}_{i}(\nu)\right\|^{2{\mathsf{p}}}\right]^{\frac{1}{2{\mathsf{p}}}}\leq

\displaystyle\mathbb{E}\left[\left(\left\|\int_{0}^{\nu}e^{\theta_{2}\beta}S_{i}(\beta)d\beta\right\|+\left\|\int_{0}^{\nu}e^{\theta_{2}\beta}L_{i}(\beta)dQ_{\beta}\right\|\right)^{2{\mathsf{p}}}\right]^{\frac{1}{2{\mathsf{p}}}}

\displaystyle\overset{(\star)}{\leq}

\displaystyle\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\int_{0}^{\nu}e^{\theta_{2}\beta}S_{i}(\beta)d\beta\right\|^{2{\mathsf{p}}}\right]^{\frac{1}{2{\mathsf{p}}}}+\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\int_{0}^{\nu}e^{\theta_{2}\beta}L_{i}(\beta)dQ_{\beta}\right\|^{2{\mathsf{p}}}\right]^{\frac{1}{2{\mathsf{p}}}}

\displaystyle\leq

\displaystyle\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\int_{0}^{\nu}e^{\theta_{2}\beta}\left\|S_{i}(\beta)\right\|d\beta\right\|^{2{\mathsf{p}}}\right]^{\frac{1}{2{\mathsf{p}}}}+\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\int_{0}^{\nu}e^{\theta_{2}\beta}L_{i}(\beta)dQ_{\beta}\right\|^{2{\mathsf{p}}}\right]^{\frac{1}{2{\mathsf{p}}}},\quad\forall(\nu,i)\in[\xi,t]\times\left\{1,2\right\},

where
(\star)
is due to the Minkowski’s inequality.
Using Proposition
B.1
and Lemma
B.2
then leads to

\displaystyle\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathchoice{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\displaystyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\textstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.84808pt}{3.12502pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.12645pt}{2.70836pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptscriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}_{i}(\nu)\right\|^{2{\mathsf{p}}}\right]^{\frac{1}{2{\mathsf{p}}}}

\displaystyle\leq e^{\theta_{2}\nu}\left(\frac{1-e^{-\theta_{2}\nu}}{\theta_{2}}\sup_{\beta\in[0,\nu]}\left\|S_{i}(\beta)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}+\left({\mathsf{p}}\frac{2{\mathsf{p}}-1}{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\left(\frac{1-e^{-2\theta_{2}\nu}}{\theta_{2}}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\sup_{\beta\in[0,\nu]}\left\|L_{i}(\beta)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}\right),

for all
(\nu,i)\in[\xi,t]\times\left\{1,2\right\}
.
We thus conclude that

\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathchoice{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\displaystyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\textstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.84808pt}{3.12502pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.12645pt}{2.70836pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptscriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}_{1}(\nu)\right\|^{2{\mathsf{p}}}\right]^{\frac{1}{2{\mathsf{p}}}}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathchoice{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\displaystyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\textstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.84808pt}{3.12502pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.12645pt}{2.70836pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptscriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}_{2}(\nu)\right\|^{2{\mathsf{p}}}\right]^{\frac{1}{2{\mathsf{p}}}}\\
\leq e^{2\theta_{2}\nu}\prod_{i=1}^{2}\left(\frac{1-e^{-\theta_{2}\nu}}{\theta_{2}}\sup_{\beta\in[0,\nu]}\left\|S_{i}(\beta)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}+\left({\mathsf{p}}\frac{2{\mathsf{p}}-1}{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\left(\frac{1-e^{-2\theta_{2}\nu}}{\theta_{2}}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\sup_{\beta\in[0,\nu]}\left\|L_{i}(\beta)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}\right),

for all
\nu\in[\xi,t]
.
Substituting the above bound in (
B.111
) yields

\left\|\mathchoice{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{7.3pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\displaystyle N\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{7.3pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\textstyle N\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{5.6678pt}{3.12502pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptstyle N\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.73894pt}{2.70836pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptscriptstyle N\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}(t)\right\|_{L_{{\mathsf{p}}}}\\
\leq\int_{\xi}^{t}e^{2\theta_{1}\nu}\prod_{i=1}^{2}\left(\frac{1-e^{-\theta_{2}\nu}}{\theta_{2}}\sup_{\beta\in[0,\nu]}\left\|S_{i}(\beta)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}+\left({\mathsf{p}}\frac{2{\mathsf{p}}-1}{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\left(\frac{1-e^{-2\theta_{2}\nu}}{\theta_{2}}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\sup_{\beta\in[0,\nu]}\left\|L_{i}(\beta)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}\right)d\nu,

which further implies

\left\|\mathchoice{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{7.3pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\displaystyle N\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{7.3pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\textstyle N\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{5.6678pt}{3.12502pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptstyle N\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.73894pt}{2.70836pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptscriptstyle N\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}(t)\right\|_{L_{{\mathsf{p}}}}\\
\leq\left(\int_{\xi}^{t}e^{2\theta_{1}\nu}d\nu\right)\prod_{i=1}^{2}\left(\frac{1-e^{-\theta_{2}t}}{\theta_{2}}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t]}\left\|S_{i}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}+\left({\mathsf{p}}\frac{2{\mathsf{p}}-1}{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\left(\frac{1-e^{-2\theta_{2}t}}{\theta_{2}}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t]}\left\|L_{i}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}\right),

for all
t\in[\xi,T]
.
Solving the integral on the right hand side and substituting in (
B.86
) then leads to

\displaystyle\left\|N(t)\right\|_{L_{{\mathsf{p}}}}

\displaystyle\leq\Delta_{R}\frac{e^{2\theta_{1}t}-e^{2\theta_{1}\xi}}{2\theta_{1}}\prod_{i=1}^{2}\left(\frac{1-e^{-\theta_{2}t}}{\theta_{2}}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t]}\left\|S_{i}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}+\left({\mathsf{p}}\frac{2{\mathsf{p}}-1}{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\left(\frac{1-e^{-2\theta_{2}t}}{\theta_{2}}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t]}\left\|L_{i}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}\right),

for all
t\in[\xi,T]
,
thus, establishing (
B.43
), for
{\mathsf{p}}\in\mathbb{N}_{\geq 2}
.

∎

We conclude the appendix with a couple of corollaries, starting with a corollary of the last lemma.

Corollary B.4

Consider a complete filtered probability space
\left(\Omega,\mathcal{F},\mathbb{P}\right)
with filtration
\mathfrak{F}_{t}
, and let
R\in\mathcal{M}_{2}^{loc}\left(\mathbb{R}^{n_{1}\times n_{2}}|\mathfrak{F}_{t}\right)
,
S_{1}\in\mathcal{M}_{2}^{loc}\left(\mathbb{R}^{n_{1}}|\mathfrak{F}_{t}\right)
,
S_{2}\in\mathcal{M}_{2}^{loc}\left(\mathbb{R}^{n_{2}}|\mathfrak{F}_{t}\right)
,
L_{1}\in\mathcal{M}_{2}^{loc}\left(\mathbb{R}^{n_{1}\times n_{q}}|\mathfrak{F}_{t}\right)
, and
L_{2}\in\mathcal{M}_{2}^{loc}\left(\mathbb{R}^{n_{2}\times n_{q}}|\mathfrak{F}_{t}\right)
satisfy

\displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{2}\mathbb{E}\left[\int_{0}^{T}\left(\left\|R(\nu)\right\|_{F}^{2{\mathsf{p}}}+\left\|S_{i}(\nu)\right\|^{2{\mathsf{p}}}+\left\|L_{i}(\nu)\right\|_{F}^{2{\mathsf{p}}}\right)d\nu\right]<\infty,\quad\forall{\mathsf{p}}\geq 1.

Additionally, for any
\theta_{1},\,\theta_{2}\in\mathbb{R}_{>0}
,
\xi\in\mathbb{R}_{\geq 0}
, and an
\mathfrak{F}_{t}
-adapted Brownian motion
Q_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{n_{q}}
define

N_{\left\{a,b\right\}}(t)=\int_{\xi}^{t}e^{2(\theta_{1}-\theta_{2})\nu}\mathchoice{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.81778pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\displaystyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.81778pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\textstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.81778pt$\hss\resizebox{4.84808pt}{3.12502pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.81778pt$\hss\resizebox{4.12645pt}{2.70836pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptscriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}_{\left\{a,b\right\}}(\nu)^{\top}R(\nu)\mathchoice{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.81778pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\displaystyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.81778pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\textstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.81778pt$\hss\resizebox{4.84808pt}{3.12502pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.81778pt$\hss\resizebox{4.12645pt}{2.70836pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptscriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}_{2}(\nu)d\nu\in\mathbb{R},\quad 0\leq\xi\leq t\leq T,

where

\displaystyle\mathchoice{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.81778pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\displaystyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.81778pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\textstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.81778pt$\hss\resizebox{4.84808pt}{3.12502pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.81778pt$\hss\resizebox{4.12645pt}{2.70836pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptscriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}_{a}(\xi)=\int_{0}^{\xi}e^{\theta_{2}\beta}S_{1}(\beta)d\beta\in\mathbb{R}^{n_{1}},\quad\mathchoice{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.81778pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\displaystyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.81778pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\textstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.81778pt$\hss\resizebox{4.84808pt}{3.12502pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.81778pt$\hss\resizebox{4.12645pt}{2.70836pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptscriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}_{b}(\nu)=\int_{0}^{\nu}e^{\theta_{2}\beta}\mathbbm{1}_{[\zeta_{1},\zeta_{2}]}\left(\beta\right)L_{1}(\beta)dQ_{\beta}\in\mathbb{R}^{n_{1}},

\displaystyle\mathchoice{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.81778pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\displaystyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.81778pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\textstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.81778pt$\hss\resizebox{4.84808pt}{3.12502pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.81778pt$\hss\resizebox{4.12645pt}{2.70836pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptscriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}_{2}(t)=\int_{0}^{t}e^{\theta_{2}\beta}\left[S_{2}(\beta)d\beta+L_{2}(\beta)dQ_{\beta}\right]\in\mathbb{R}^{n_{2}}.

In the above,
0\leq\zeta_{1}\leq\zeta_{2}<t
are any deterministic variables.
Then, for all
(t,{\mathsf{p}})\in[\xi,T]\times\mathbb{N}_{\geq 1}

\mathbb{E}\left[\left|N_{a}(t)\right|^{\mathsf{p}}\right]^{\frac{1}{{\mathsf{p}}}}\leq\frac{\Delta_{R}}{2}\frac{e^{2\theta_{1}t}-e^{2\theta_{1}\xi}}{\theta_{1}\theta_{2}}\left(e^{\theta_{2}\xi}-1\right)\sup_{\nu\in[0,t]}\left\|S_{1}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}\\
\times\left(\frac{1-e^{-\theta_{2}t}}{\theta_{2}}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t]}\left\|S_{2}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}+\left({\mathsf{p}}\frac{2{\mathsf{p}}-1}{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\left(\frac{1-e^{-2\theta_{2}t}}{\theta_{2}}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t]}\left\|L_{2}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}\right),

(B.112)

and

\mathbb{E}\left[\left|N_{b}(t)\right|^{\mathsf{p}}\right]^{\frac{1}{{\mathsf{p}}}}\leq\frac{\Delta_{R}}{2}\left({\mathsf{p}}\frac{2{\mathsf{p}}-1}{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\frac{e^{2\theta_{1}t}-e^{2\theta_{1}(\xi\vee\zeta_{1})}}{\theta_{1}\sqrt{\theta_{2}}}\left(1-e^{-2\theta_{2}(\zeta_{2}-\zeta_{1})}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\sup_{\nu\in[\zeta_{1},\zeta_{2}]}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|L_{1}(\nu)\right\|^{2{\mathsf{p}}}\right]^{\frac{1}{2{\mathsf{p}}}}\\
\times\left(\frac{1-e^{-\theta_{2}t}}{\theta_{2}}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t]}\left\|S_{2}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}+\left({\mathsf{p}}\frac{2{\mathsf{p}}-1}{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\left(\frac{1-e^{-2\theta_{2}t}}{\theta_{2}}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t]}\left\|L_{2}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}\right).

(B.113)

Proof.

We provide a proof for the case
{\mathsf{p}}\in\mathbb{N}_{\geq 2}
only and begin by writing

N(t)=N_{a}(t)+N_{b}(t),\quad t\in[\xi,T],

where

\displaystyle N_{\left\{a,b\right\}}(t)=\int_{\xi}^{t}e^{2(\theta_{1}-\theta_{2})\nu}\mathchoice{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\displaystyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\textstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.84808pt}{3.12502pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.12645pt}{2.70836pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptscriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}_{\left\{a,b\right\}}(\nu)^{\top}R(\nu)\mathchoice{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\displaystyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\textstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.84808pt}{3.12502pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.12645pt}{2.70836pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptscriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}_{2}(\nu)d\nu,

\displaystyle\mathchoice{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\displaystyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\textstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.84808pt}{3.12502pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.12645pt}{2.70836pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptscriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}_{a}(\xi)=\int_{0}^{\xi}e^{\theta_{2}\beta}S_{1}(\beta)d\beta,\quad\mathchoice{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\displaystyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\textstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.84808pt}{3.12502pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.12645pt}{2.70836pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptscriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}_{b}(\nu)=\int_{0}^{\nu}e^{\theta_{2}\beta}\mathbbm{1}_{[\zeta_{1},\zeta_{2}]}\left(\beta\right)L_{1}(\beta)dQ_{\beta}.

Now, following the proof of Lemma
B.6
with
\mathchoice{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\displaystyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\textstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.84808pt}{3.12502pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.12645pt}{2.70836pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptscriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}_{1}
replaced by
\mathchoice{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\displaystyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\textstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.84808pt}{3.12502pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.12645pt}{2.70836pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptscriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}_{a}
leads to

\begin{aligned} &\mathbb{E}\left[\left|N_{a}(t)\right|^{\mathsf{p}}\right]^{\frac{1}{{\mathsf{p}}}}\\
&\leq\Delta_{R}\left(\int_{\xi}^{t}e^{(2\theta_{1}-\theta_{2})\nu}d\nu\right)\left(\frac{e^{\theta_{2}\xi}-1}{\theta_{2}}\sup_{\nu\in[0,\xi]}\left\|S_{1}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}\right)\end{aligned}\\
\times\left(\frac{1-e^{-\theta_{2}t}}{\theta_{2}}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t]}\left\|S_{2}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}+\left({\mathsf{p}}\frac{2{\mathsf{p}}-1}{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\left(\frac{1-e^{-2\theta_{2}t}}{\theta_{2}}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t]}\left\|L_{2}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}\right),

for all
t\in[\xi,T]
.
Note that since

\displaystyle\int_{\xi}^{t}e^{(2\theta_{1}-\theta_{2})\nu}d\nu\leq\int_{\xi}^{t}e^{2\theta_{1}\nu}d\nu=\frac{e^{2\theta_{1}t}-e^{2\theta_{1}\xi}}{2\theta_{1}},

we can write the previous bound as

\mathbb{E}\left[\left|N_{a}(t)\right|^{\mathsf{p}}\right]^{\frac{1}{{\mathsf{p}}}}\leq\frac{\Delta_{R}}{2}\frac{e^{2\theta_{1}t}-e^{2\theta_{1}\xi}}{\theta_{1}\theta_{2}}\left(e^{\theta_{2}\xi}-1\right)\sup_{\nu\in[0,t]}\left\|S_{1}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}\\
\times\left(\frac{1-e^{-\theta_{2}t}}{\theta_{2}}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t]}\left\|S_{2}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}+\left({\mathsf{p}}\frac{2{\mathsf{p}}-1}{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\left(\frac{1-e^{-2\theta_{2}t}}{\theta_{2}}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t]}\left\|L_{2}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}\right),

for all
t\in[\xi,T]
, where have also used the bound
\sup_{\nu\in[0,\xi]}\left\|S_{1}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}\leq\sup_{\nu\in[0,t]}\left\|S_{1}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}
, thus proving (
B.112
).

Next, as at the beginning of the proof of Lemma
B.3
, we can write

\displaystyle N_{b}(t)=

\displaystyle\int_{\xi}^{t}e^{2(\theta_{1}-\theta_{2})\nu}\left(\int_{0}^{\nu}e^{\theta_{2}\beta}\mathbbm{1}_{[\zeta_{1},\zeta_{2}]}\left(\beta\right)L_{1}(\beta)dQ_{\beta}\right)^{\top}R(\nu)\mathchoice{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\displaystyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\textstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.84808pt}{3.12502pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.12645pt}{2.70836pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptscriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}_{2}(\nu)d\nu

\displaystyle=

\displaystyle\int_{{\xi\vee\zeta_{1}}}^{t}e^{2(\theta_{1}-\theta_{2})\nu}\left(\int_{\zeta_{1}}^{\nu\wedge\zeta_{2}}e^{\theta_{2}\beta}L_{1}(\beta)dQ_{\beta}\right)^{\top}R(\nu)\mathchoice{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\displaystyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\textstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.84808pt}{3.12502pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.12645pt}{2.70836pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptscriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}_{2}(\nu)d\nu,\quad\forall t\in[\xi,T].

Therefore, as in (
B.16
), and using the bound on
\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\mathchoice{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\displaystyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{6.13614pt}{3.8889pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\textstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.84808pt}{3.12502pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}{\mathop{\vbox{\halign{#\cr\kern 0.80002pt$\hss\resizebox{4.12645pt}{2.70836pt}{\rotatebox[origin={c}]{90.0}{(}}\hss$\crcr\cr$\hss\scriptscriptstyle R\hss$\crcr}}}\limits}_{2}(\nu)\right\|^{2{\mathsf{p}}}\right]^{\frac{1}{2{\mathsf{p}}}}
in the proof of Lemma
B.6
, we obtain

\begin{aligned} &\mathbb{E}\left[\left|N_{b}(t)\right|^{\mathsf{p}}\right]^{\frac{1}{{\mathsf{p}}}}\\
&\leq\Delta_{R}\left(\int_{\xi\vee\zeta_{1}}^{t}e^{2\theta_{1}\nu}d\nu\right)\left({\mathsf{p}}\frac{2{\mathsf{p}}-1}{2\theta_{2}}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\left(1-e^{-2\theta_{2}(\zeta_{2}-\zeta_{1})}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\sup_{\nu\in[\zeta_{1},\zeta_{2}]}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|L_{1}(\nu)\right\|^{2{\mathsf{p}}}\right]^{\frac{1}{2{\mathsf{p}}}}\end{aligned}\\
\times\left(\frac{1-e^{-\theta_{2}t}}{\theta_{2}}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t]}\left\|S_{2}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}+\left({\mathsf{p}}\frac{2{\mathsf{p}}-1}{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\left(\frac{1-e^{-2\theta_{2}t}}{\theta_{2}}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t]}\left\|L_{2}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}\right),

for all
t\in[\xi,T]
, which then leads to

\mathbb{E}\left[\left|N_{b}(t)\right|^{\mathsf{p}}\right]^{\frac{1}{{\mathsf{p}}}}\leq\frac{\Delta_{R}}{2}\left({\mathsf{p}}\frac{2{\mathsf{p}}-1}{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\frac{e^{2\theta_{1}t}-e^{2\theta_{1}(\xi\vee\zeta_{1})}}{\theta_{1}\sqrt{\theta_{2}}}\left(1-e^{-2\theta_{2}(\zeta_{2}-\zeta_{1})}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\sup_{\nu\in[\zeta_{1},\zeta_{2}]}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|L_{1}(\nu)\right\|^{2{\mathsf{p}}}\right]^{\frac{1}{2{\mathsf{p}}}}\\
\times\left(\frac{1-e^{-\theta_{2}t}}{\theta_{2}}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t]}\left\|S_{2}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}+\left({\mathsf{p}}\frac{2{\mathsf{p}}-1}{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\left(\frac{1-e^{-2\theta_{2}t}}{\theta_{2}}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t]}\left\|L_{2}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}\right),

for all
t\in[\xi,T]
, thus proving (
B.113
).

∎

The final result considers a particular process resulting from the piecewise nature of the adaptation law.

Corollary B.5

Consider a complete filtered probability space
\left(\Omega,\mathcal{F},\mathbb{P}\right)

Proof.

Then,

\displaystyle\begin{multlined}\int_{0}^{\tau(t)}e^{2\lambda\nu}\left(\nabla\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\nu}\right)^{\top}G_{\mu}\left(\nu,Y_{N,\nu}\right)+\frac{1}{2}\text{Tr}\left[H_{\sigma}\left(\nu,Y_{N,\nu}\right)\nabla^{2}\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\nu}\right)\right]\right)d\nu\\

\leq-2\lambda\int_{0}^{\tau(t)}e^{2\lambda\nu}\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\nu}\right)d\nu+\int_{0}^{\tau(t)}e^{2\lambda\nu}\phi^{r}_{U}\left(\nu,Y_{N,\nu}\right)d\nu\\
+\int_{0}^{\tau(t)}e^{2\lambda\nu}\left(\phi^{r}_{\mu}\left(\nu,Y_{N,\nu}\right)+\phi^{r}_{\mu^{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.0pt}{\resizebox{5.31639pt}{4.5pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\displaystyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.0pt}{\resizebox{5.31639pt}{4.5pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.25pt}{$\textstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.7pt}{\resizebox{3.3858pt}{3.15pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.5pt}{\resizebox{2.8858pt}{2.25pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.625pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}}}\left(\nu,Y_{N,\nu}\right)\right)d\nu,

Proof.

+2\left(X^{r}_{N,\nu}-X^{\star}_{N,\nu}\right)^{\top}\left(g(\nu)U^{r}_{\nu}+\Lambda_{\mu}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)\right),\quad\nu\in[0,\tau(t)],

Substituting the expression above for the two identical inner integrals on the right hand side of (

) produces (

), thus completing the proof upon re-arranging terms.

∎

The next result provides an alternative representation of
\mathcal{P}^{r}
that is amenable to the analysis of the reference process.

Proposition C.3

Recall the expression for
\mathcal{P}^{r}\left(\tau(t),\nu\right)
in (
41
) in the statement of Lemma
4.1
, which we restate below:

\displaystyle\mathcal{P}^{r}\left(\tau(t),\nu\right)=\int_{\nu}^{\tau(t)}e^{(2\lambda-{\color[rgb]{1,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{1,0,1}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@stroke{0}{1}{0}{0}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@fill{0}{1}{0}{0}\bm{\omega}})\beta}d_{\beta}\left[\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)^{\top}g(\beta)\right]\in\mathbb{R}^{1\times m},\quad 0\leq\nu\leq\tau(t),

(C.13)

where
\tau(t)
is defined in (
34
), and
\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,t}\right)\doteq\partial_{X^{r}_{N}-X^{\star}_{N}}\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N}\right)=2\left(X^{r}_{N}-X^{\star}_{N}\right)\in\mathbb{R}^{n}
.
Then,
\mathcal{P}^{r}\left(\tau(t),\nu\right)
admits the following representation:

\mathcal{P}^{r}\left(\tau(t),\nu\right)=\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\circ}\left(\tau(t),\nu\right)+\mathcal{P}^{r}_{ad}\left(\tau(t),\nu\right)\in\mathbb{R}^{1\times m},\quad 0\leq\nu\leq\tau(t),~t\in\mathbb{R}_{\geq 0},

(C.14)

where

\displaystyle\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\circ}\left(\tau(t),\nu\right)=\int_{\nu}^{\tau(t)}e^{(2\lambda-{\color[rgb]{1,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{1,0,1}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@stroke{0}{1}{0}{0}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@fill{0}{1}{0}{0}\bm{\omega}})\beta}\left(\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\mu}(\beta)d\beta+\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma}(\beta)dW_{\beta}+\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma_{\star}}(\beta)dW^{\star}_{\beta}\right)^{\top}\in\mathbb{R}^{1\times m},

(C.15a)

\displaystyle\mathcal{P}^{r}_{ad}\left(\tau(t),\nu\right)=\int_{\nu}^{\tau(t)}e^{(2\lambda-{\color[rgb]{1,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{1,0,1}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@stroke{0}{1}{0}{0}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@fill{0}{1}{0}{0}\bm{\omega}})\beta}\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\mathcal{U}}(\beta)^{\top}d\beta\in\mathbb{R}^{1\times m},

(C.15b)

and where
\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\mathcal{U}}(\beta),\,\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\mu}(\beta)\in\mathbb{R}^{m}
and
\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma}(\beta),\,\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma_{\star}}(\beta)\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times d}
are defined as

\displaystyle\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\mu}(\beta)=\dot{g}(\beta)^{\top}\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)+2g(\beta)^{\top}\left(\bar{F}_{\mu}\left(\beta,X^{r}_{N,\beta}\right)-\bar{F}_{\mu}\left(\beta,X^{\star}_{N,\beta}\right)+\Lambda_{\mu}\left(\beta,X^{r}_{N,\beta}\right)\right),

\displaystyle\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\mathcal{U}}(\beta)=2g(\beta)^{\top}g(\beta)U^{r}_{\beta},

\displaystyle\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma}(\beta)=2g(\beta)^{\top}F_{\sigma}\left(\beta,X^{r}_{N,\beta}\right),\quad\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma_{\star}}(\beta)=-2g(\beta)^{\top}\bar{F}_{\sigma}\left(\beta,X^{\star}_{N,\beta}\right).

Proof.

We begin by writing
\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)^{\top}g(\beta)
as

\displaystyle\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)^{\top}g(\beta)=

\displaystyle\begin{bmatrix}\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)^{\top}g_{\cdot,1}(\beta)&\cdots&\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)^{\top}g_{\cdot,m}(\beta)\end{bmatrix}

\displaystyle=

\displaystyle\begin{bmatrix}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\partial_{i}\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)g_{i,1}(\beta)&\cdots&\sum_{i=1}^{n}\partial_{i}\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)g_{i,m}(\beta)\end{bmatrix}\in\mathbb{R}^{1\times m},

(C.16)

where
g_{\cdot,j}(\beta)\in\mathbb{R}^{n}
is the
j
-th column of
g(\beta)
, and

\displaystyle\partial_{i}\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)\doteq\frac{\partial}{\partial\left(X^{r}_{N}-X^{\star}_{N}\right)_{i}}\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)=2\left(X^{r}_{N,\beta}-X^{\star}_{N,\beta}\right)_{i}\in\mathbb{R},\quad i\in\left\{1,\dots,n\right\}.

Applying Itô’s lemma to
\partial_{i}\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)g_{i,j}(\beta)\in\mathbb{R}
,
(i,j)\in\left\{1,\dots,n\right\}\times\left\{1,\dots,m\right\}
, and using the truncated dynamics in (
31
) we get

d_{\beta}\left[\partial_{i}\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)g_{i,j}(\beta)\right]=\left(\partial_{i}\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)\dot{g}_{i,j}(\beta)+\nabla\partial_{i}\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)^{\top}G_{\mu}\left(\beta,Y_{N,\beta}\right)g_{i,j}(\beta)\right)d\beta\\
+\nabla\partial_{i}\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)^{\top}G_{\sigma}\left(\beta,Y_{N,\beta}\right)g_{i,j}(\beta)d\widehat{W}_{\beta},

(C.17)

where we have used the straightforward fact that
\nabla^{2}\partial_{i}\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)=0\in\mathbb{S}^{2n}
.
We have further replaced
G_{N,\mu}
and
G_{N,\sigma}
with
G_{\mu}
and
G_{\sigma}
because from Proposition
4.1
,
Y_{N,\beta}
is also a strong solution of the joint process (
29
) for all
\beta\in[\nu,\tau(t)]\subseteq[0,\tau^{\star}]\subseteq[0,\tau_{N}]
.
Observe from (
C
) that

\displaystyle d_{\beta}\left[\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)^{\top}g_{\cdot,j}(\beta)\right]=\sum_{i=1}^{n}d_{\beta}\left[\partial_{i}\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)g_{i,j}(\beta)\right]\in\mathbb{R},\quad j\in\left\{1,\dots,m\right\}.

It therefore follows from the expression in (
C.17
)

d_{\beta}\left[\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)^{\top}g_{\cdot,j}(\beta)\right]=\sum_{i=1}^{n}\left(\partial_{i}\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)\dot{g}_{i,j}(\beta)+\nabla\partial_{i}\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)^{\top}G_{\mu}\left(\beta,Y_{N,\beta}\right)g_{i,j}(\beta)\right)d\beta\\
+\sum_{i=1}^{n}\nabla\partial_{i}\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)^{\top}G_{\sigma}\left(\beta,Y_{N,\beta}\right)g_{i,j}(\beta)d\widehat{W}_{\beta},

which can be further written as

d_{\beta}\left[\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)^{\top}g_{\cdot,j}(\beta)\right]=\left(\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)^{\top}\dot{g}_{\cdot,j}(\beta)+g_{\cdot,j}(\beta)^{\top}\nabla\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)^{\top}G_{\mu}\left(\beta,Y_{N,\beta}\right)\right)d\beta\\
+g_{\cdot,j}(\beta)^{\top}\nabla\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)^{\top}G_{\sigma}\left(\beta,Y_{N,\beta}\right)d\widehat{W}_{\beta}\in\mathbb{R},

(C.18)

for
j\in\left\{1,\dots,m\right\}
.
Once again, (
C
) implies that

\displaystyle d_{\beta}\left[\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)^{\top}g(\beta)\right]=\begin{bmatrix}d_{\beta}\left[\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)^{\top}g_{\cdot,1}(\beta)\right]&\cdots&d_{\beta}\left[\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)^{\top}g_{\cdot,m}(\beta)\right]\end{bmatrix}\in\mathbb{R}^{1\times m}.

Thus, we use the expression in (
C.18
) to write

d_{\beta}\left[\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)^{\top}g(\beta)\right]=\left(\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)^{\top}\dot{g}(\beta)+\left(g(\beta)^{\top}\nabla\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)^{\top}G_{\mu}\left(\beta,Y_{N,\beta}\right)\right)^{\top}\right)d\beta\\
+\left(g(\beta)^{\top}\nabla\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)^{\top}G_{\sigma}\left(\beta,Y_{N,\beta}\right)d\widehat{W}_{\beta}\right)^{\top}\in\mathbb{R}^{1\times m}.

(C.19)

Now, using the definition of the gradient of vector valued functions in Sec.
1.4
, we observe that

\displaystyle\nabla\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)=2\begin{bmatrix}\nabla\left(X^{r}_{N,\beta}-X^{\star}_{N,\beta}\right)_{1}&\cdots&\nabla\left(X^{r}_{N,\beta}-X^{\star}_{N,\beta}\right)_{n}\end{bmatrix}=2\begin{bmatrix}\mathbb{I}_{n}\\
-\mathbb{I}_{n}\end{bmatrix}\in\mathbb{R}^{2n\times n}.

Thus, it follows from the definitions of the vector fields in (
29
) that

\displaystyle\nabla\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)^{\top}G_{\mu}\left(\beta,Y_{N,\beta}\right)=

\displaystyle 2\left(F_{\mu}\left(\beta,X^{r}_{N,\beta},U^{r}_{\beta}\right)-\bar{F}_{\mu}\left(\beta,X^{\star}_{N,\beta}\right)\right)

\displaystyle=

\displaystyle 2\bar{F}_{\mu}\left(\beta,X^{r}_{N,\beta}\right)+2\Lambda_{\mu}\left(\beta,X^{r}_{N,\beta}\right)-2\bar{F}_{\mu}\left(\beta,X^{\star}_{N,\beta}\right)+2g(\beta)U^{r}_{\beta}\in\mathbb{R}^{n},

\displaystyle\nabla\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)^{\top}G_{\sigma}\left(\beta,Y_{N,\beta}\right)=

\displaystyle 2\begin{bmatrix}F_{\sigma}\left(\beta,X^{r}_{N,\beta}\right)&-\bar{F}_{\sigma}\left(\beta,X^{\star}_{N,\beta}\right)\end{bmatrix}\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times 2d},

where we have used the following decomposition from (
3
) in Definition
1
:

\displaystyle F_{\mu}\left(\beta,X^{r}_{N,\beta},U^{r}_{\beta}\right)=\bar{F}_{\mu}\left(\beta,X^{r}_{N,\beta}\right)+g(\beta)U^{r}_{\beta}+\Lambda_{\mu}\left(\beta,X^{r}_{N,\beta}\right).

Substituting the above identities into (
C.19
) produces

\displaystyle d_{\beta}\left[\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\beta}\right)^{\top}g(\beta)\right]=\left[\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\mu}(\beta)+\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\mathcal{U}}(\beta)\right]^{\top}d\beta+\left[\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma}(\beta)dW_{\beta}+\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma_{\star}}(\beta)dW^{\star}_{\beta}\right]^{\top}\in\mathbb{R}^{1\times m}.

Then, (
C.14
) is established by substituting the above into (
C.13
).

∎

The next result establishes the bounds for the pertinent entities in the last proposition.

Proposition C.4

If the stopping time
\tau^{\star}
, defined in (
34
), Lemma
4.1
, satisfies
\tau^{\star}=t^{\star}
, then the functions
\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\mu}(t)\in\mathbb{R}^{m}
and
\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma}(t),\,\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma_{\star}}(t)\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times d}
defined in the statement of Proposition
C.3
satisfy the following bounds for any
{\mathsf{p}}\in\mathbb{R}_{\geq 1}
:

\displaystyle\sup_{\nu\in[0,t^{\star}]}\left\|\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\mu}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\leq 2\Delta_{g}\Delta^{r}_{\mathcal{P}_{\mu}}({\mathsf{p}})+\Delta_{\dot{g}}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t^{\star}]}\left\|\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}},

(C.20a)

\displaystyle\sum_{i\in\left\{\sigma,\sigma_{\star}\right\}}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t^{\star}]}\left\|\mathcal{P}^{r}_{i}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\leq 2\Delta_{g}\Delta^{r}_{\mathcal{P}_{\sigma}}({\mathsf{p}}),

(C.20b)

where

\displaystyle\Delta^{r}_{\mathcal{P}_{\mu}}({\mathsf{p}})=\sup_{\nu\in[0,t^{\star}]}\left(\left\|\bar{F}_{\mu}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)-\bar{F}_{\mu}\left(\nu,X^{\star}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}+\left\|\Lambda_{\mu}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\right),

\displaystyle\Delta^{r}_{\mathcal{P}_{\sigma}}({\mathsf{p}})=\sup_{\nu\in[0,t^{\star}]}\left(\left\|\bar{F}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}+\left\|\Lambda_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\right)+\sup_{\nu\in[0,t^{\star}]}\left\|\bar{F}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{\star}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}.

Proof.

We begin by using the definition of
\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\mu}
in (
C.15a
) to obtain

\displaystyle\left\|\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\mu}(\nu)\right\|\leq\Delta_{\dot{g}}\left\|\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|+2\Delta_{g}\left(\left\|\bar{F}_{\mu}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)-\bar{F}_{\mu}\left(\nu,X^{\star}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|+\left\|\Lambda_{\mu}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|\right),

for all
\nu\in[0,t^{\star}]
, where we have used the bounds on
g(t)
and
\dot{g}(t)
in Assumption
1
.
It then follows from the Minkowski’s inequality that

\displaystyle\left\|\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\mu}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\leq\Delta_{\dot{g}}\left\|\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}+2\Delta_{g}\left(\left\|\bar{F}_{\mu}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)-\bar{F}_{\mu}\left(\nu,X^{\star}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}+\left\|\Lambda_{\mu}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\right),

for all
\nu\in[0,t^{\star}]
, which in turn implies (
C.20a
).

Next, using the definitions of
\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma}
and
\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma_{\star}}
, we obtain

\displaystyle\left\|\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma}(\nu)\right\|_{F}\leq 2\Delta_{g}\left\|F_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{F},\quad\left\|\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma_{\star}}(\nu)\right\|_{F}\leq 2\Delta_{g}\left\|\bar{F}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{\star}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{F},\quad\forall\nu\in[0,t^{\star}],

where we have used the bound on
g(t)
in Assumption
1
.
It then follows from the decomposition
F_{\sigma}=\bar{F}_{\sigma}+\Lambda_{\sigma}
in (
3
) that

\left\|\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma}(\nu)\right\|_{F}\leq 2\Delta_{g}\left(\left\|\bar{F}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{F}+\left\|\Lambda_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{F}\right),\\
\left\|\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma_{\star}}(\nu)\right\|_{F}\leq 2\Delta_{g}\left\|\bar{F}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{\star}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{F},\quad\forall\nu\in[0,t^{\star}].

From the Minkowski’s inequality, we get

\left\|\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\leq 2\Delta_{g}\left(\left\|\bar{F}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}+\left\|\Lambda_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\right),\\
\left\|\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma_{\star}}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\leq 2\Delta_{g}\left\|\bar{F}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{\star}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}},\quad\forall\nu\in[0,t^{\star}],

which then leads to (
C.20b
) in a straightforward manner.

∎

Applying Proposition
B.2
for
\left\{\theta_{1},\theta_{2},\xi,S_{1},S_{2}\right\}=\left\{2\lambda,{\color[rgb]{1,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{1,0,1}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@stroke{0}{1}{0}{0}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@fill{0}{1}{0}{0}\bm{\omega}},0,\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\mu_{i}},\Lambda_{\mu}^{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.98pt}{\resizebox{4.27098pt}{4.40999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.7pt}{\resizebox{3.57098pt}{3.15pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}}\right\}

\displaystyle\left\|N^{r}_{3}(t)\right\|_{L_{{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\leq\left({\mathsf{p}}({\mathsf{p}}-1)\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\frac{e^{2\lambda t}}{2\sqrt{2\lambda}{\color[rgb]{1,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{1,0,1}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@stroke{0}{1}{0}{0}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@fill{0}{1}{0}{0}\bm{\omega}}}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t^{\star}]}\left\|\Lambda_{\mu}^{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.98pt}{\resizebox{4.27098pt}{4.40999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.7pt}{\resizebox{3.57098pt}{3.15pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t^{\star}]}\left(\left\|\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}+\left\|\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma_{\star}}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\right),

(C.28)

for all

Additionally, using

, one obtains

(C.29)

Finally, consider the process

given as

N^{r}_{4}(t)=\int_{0}^{t}e^{{\color[rgb]{1,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{1,0,1}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@stroke{0}{1}{0}{0}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@fill{0}{1}{0}{0}\bm{\omega}}\nu}M_{\sigma}(t,\nu)F^{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.98pt}{\resizebox{4.27098pt}{4.40999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.7pt}{\resizebox{3.57098pt}{3.15pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)dW_{\nu}\\

It then follows from Lemma

that

\displaystyle\mathbb{E}\left[N_{4}^{r}(t)\right]\leq

\displaystyle\sqrt{m}\frac{e^{2\lambda t}}{2\lambda}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t^{\star}]}\mathbb{E}\left[\left\|\begin{bmatrix}\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma}(\nu)&\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma_{\star}}(\nu)\end{bmatrix}F^{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.98pt}{\resizebox{4.27098pt}{4.40999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.7pt}{\resizebox{3.57098pt}{3.15pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)^{\top}\right\|_{F}\right],\quad\forall t\in[0,t^{\star}],

and

+\sqrt{m}\frac{e^{2\lambda t}}{2\lambda}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t^{\star}]}\left\|\begin{bmatrix}\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma}(\nu)&\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma_{\star}}(\nu)\end{bmatrix}F^{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.98pt}{\resizebox{4.27098pt}{4.40999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.7pt}{\resizebox{3.57098pt}{3.15pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)^{\top}\right\|_{L_{{\mathsf{p}}}},

for all
(t,{\mathsf{p}})\in[0,t^{\star}]\times\mathbb{N}_{\geq 2}
.
Now, using the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality and (

\displaystyle\left\|\begin{bmatrix}\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma}(\nu)&\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma_{\star}}(\nu)\end{bmatrix}F^{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.98pt}{\resizebox{4.27098pt}{4.40999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.7pt}{\resizebox{3.57098pt}{3.15pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)^{\top}\right\|_{L_{\mathsf{q}}}\leq

\displaystyle\left\|\begin{bmatrix}\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma}(\nu)&\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma_{\star}}(\nu)\end{bmatrix}\right\|_{L_{2\mathsf{q}}}\left\|F^{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.98pt}{\resizebox{4.27098pt}{4.40999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.7pt}{\resizebox{3.57098pt}{3.15pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)^{\top}\right\|_{L_{2\mathsf{q}}}

\displaystyle\leq

\displaystyle\left(\left\|\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2\mathsf{q}}}^{y_{0}}+\left\|\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma_{\star}}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2\mathsf{q}}}^{y_{0}}\right)\left\|F^{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.98pt}{\resizebox{4.27098pt}{4.40999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.7pt}{\resizebox{3.57098pt}{3.15pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)^{\top}\right\|_{L_{2\mathsf{q}}}^{y_{0}},

\times\sup_{\nu\in[0,t^{\star}]}\left(\left\|\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}+\left\|\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\sigma_{\star}}(\nu)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\right)\sup_{\nu\in[0,t^{\star}]}\left\|F^{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.98pt}{\resizebox{4.27098pt}{4.40999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.7pt}{\resizebox{3.57098pt}{3.15pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)^{\top}\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}},

Similar to the last proposition, the following result establishes the bound on the input to the reference system.

Proposition C.6

Consider the following scalar process:

\displaystyle N^{r}_{\mathcal{U}}(t)=\int_{0}^{t}e^{{\color[rgb]{1,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{1,0,1}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@stroke{0}{1}{0}{0}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@fill{0}{1}{0}{0}\bm{\omega}}\nu}M_{\mathcal{U}}(t,\nu)\left(\Lambda_{\mu}^{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.98pt}{\resizebox{4.27098pt}{4.40999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.7pt}{\resizebox{3.57098pt}{3.15pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)d\nu+F^{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.98pt}{\resizebox{4.27098pt}{4.40999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.7pt}{\resizebox{3.57098pt}{3.15pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)dW_{\nu}\right),

(C.34)

where

\displaystyle M_{\mathcal{U}}(t,\nu)=\int_{\nu}^{t}e^{(2\lambda-{\color[rgb]{1,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{1,0,1}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@stroke{0}{1}{0}{0}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@fill{0}{1}{0}{0}\bm{\omega}})\beta}\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\mathcal{U}}(\beta)^{\top}d\beta,

for
0\leq\nu\leq t\leq T
, and where
\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\mathcal{U}}(\beta)\in\mathbb{R}^{m}
is defined in the statement of Proposition
C.3
.
If the stopping time
\tau^{\star}
, defined in (
34
), Lemma
4.1
, satisfies
\tau^{\star}=t^{\star}
, then

\displaystyle\left\|N^{r}_{\mathcal{U}}(t)\right\|_{L_{{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\leq\Delta_{g}^{2}\frac{e^{2\lambda t}}{\lambda}\left(\frac{1}{{\color[rgb]{1,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{1,0,1}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@stroke{0}{1}{0}{0}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@fill{0}{1}{0}{0}\bm{\sqrt{\omega}}}}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t^{\star}]}\left\|\Lambda_{\mu}^{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.98pt}{\resizebox{4.27098pt}{4.40999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.7pt}{\resizebox{3.57098pt}{3.15pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}+\left({\mathsf{p}}\frac{2{\mathsf{p}}-1}{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t^{\star}]}\left\|F^{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.98pt}{\resizebox{4.27098pt}{4.40999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.7pt}{\resizebox{3.57098pt}{3.15pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\right)^{2},

(C.35)

for all
(t,{\mathsf{p}})\in[0,t^{\star}]\times\mathbb{N}_{\geq 1}
.

Proof.

We begin by decomposing the process
N^{r}_{\mathcal{U}}(t)
as follows:

N^{r}_{\mathcal{U}}(t)=N^{r}_{\mathcal{U}_{1}}(t)+N^{r}_{\mathcal{U}_{2}}(t),

(C.36)

where

\displaystyle N^{r}_{\mathcal{U}_{1}}(t)=\int_{0}^{t}e^{{\color[rgb]{1,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{1,0,1}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@stroke{0}{1}{0}{0}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@fill{0}{1}{0}{0}\bm{\omega}}\nu}M_{\mathcal{U}}(t,\nu)\Lambda_{\mu}^{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.98pt}{\resizebox{4.27098pt}{4.40999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.7pt}{\resizebox{3.57098pt}{3.15pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)d\nu,\quad N^{r}_{\mathcal{U}_{2}}(t)=\int_{0}^{t}e^{{\color[rgb]{1,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{1,0,1}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@stroke{0}{1}{0}{0}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@fill{0}{1}{0}{0}\bm{\omega}}\nu}M_{\mathcal{U}}(t,\nu)F^{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.98pt}{\resizebox{4.27098pt}{4.40999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.7pt}{\resizebox{3.57098pt}{3.15pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)dW_{\nu}.

Now, consider the process
N^{r}_{\mathcal{U}_{1}}(t)
, which, using the definition of
M_{\mathcal{U}}
can be written as

N^{r}_{\mathcal{U}_{1}}(t)=\int_{0}^{t}e^{{\color[rgb]{1,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{1,0,1}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@stroke{0}{1}{0}{0}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@fill{0}{1}{0}{0}\bm{\omega}}\nu}M_{\mathcal{U}}(t,\nu)\Lambda_{\mu}^{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.98pt}{\resizebox{4.27098pt}{4.40999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.7pt}{\resizebox{3.57098pt}{3.15pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)d\nu\\
=\int_{0}^{t}e^{{\color[rgb]{1,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{1,0,1}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@stroke{0}{1}{0}{0}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@fill{0}{1}{0}{0}\bm{\omega}}\nu}\int_{\nu}^{t}e^{(2\lambda-{\color[rgb]{1,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{1,0,1}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@stroke{0}{1}{0}{0}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@fill{0}{1}{0}{0}\bm{\omega}})\beta}\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\mathcal{U}}(\beta)^{\top}d\beta\Lambda_{\mu}^{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.98pt}{\resizebox{4.27098pt}{4.40999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.7pt}{\resizebox{3.57098pt}{3.15pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)d\nu\\
=\int_{0}^{t}\int_{\nu}^{t}e^{{\color[rgb]{1,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{1,0,1}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@stroke{0}{1}{0}{0}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@fill{0}{1}{0}{0}\bm{\omega}}\nu}e^{(2\lambda-{\color[rgb]{1,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{1,0,1}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@stroke{0}{1}{0}{0}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@fill{0}{1}{0}{0}\bm{\omega}})\beta}\mathcal{P}^{r}_{\mathcal{U}}(\beta)^{\top}\Lambda_{\mu}^{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.98pt}{\resizebox{4.27098pt}{4.40999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.7pt}{\resizebox{3.57098pt}{3.15pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)d\beta d\nu.

Since the integral above is a nested Lebesgue integral with

\displaystyle L_{1}(t)=L_{2}(t)=\begin{bmatrix}F^{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.98pt}{\resizebox{4.27098pt}{4.40999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.7pt}{\resizebox{3.57098pt}{3.15pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}}_{\sigma}\left(t,X^{r}_{N,t}\right)&0_{m,d}\end{bmatrix}\in\mathcal{M}_{2}^{loc}\left(\mathbb{R}^{m\times 2d}|\mathfrak{W}_{t}\times\mathfrak{W}^{\star}_{t}\right).

Furthermore, as a consequence of Assumption
1
, we may set
\Delta_{R}
in the hypothesis of Lemma
B.6
as
\Delta_{R}=2\Delta_{g}^{2}{\color[rgb]{1,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{1,0,1}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@stroke{0}{1}{0}{0}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@fill{0}{1}{0}{0}\bm{\omega}}
.
Hence, applying Lemma
B.6
to the process
N^{r}_{\mathcal{U}}(t)
in (
C.40
) leads to

\left\|N^{r}_{\mathcal{U}}(t)\right\|_{L_{{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\leq\Delta_{g}^{2}{\color[rgb]{1,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{1,0,1}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@stroke{0}{1}{0}{0}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@fill{0}{1}{0}{0}\bm{\omega}}\frac{e^{2\lambda t}-1}{\lambda}\left(\frac{1-e^{-{\color[rgb]{1,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{1,0,1}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@stroke{0}{1}{0}{0}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@fill{0}{1}{0}{0}\bm{\omega}}t}}{{\color[rgb]{1,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{1,0,1}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@stroke{0}{1}{0}{0}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@fill{0}{1}{0}{0}\bm{\omega}}}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t^{\star}]}\left\|\Lambda_{\mu}^{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.98pt}{\resizebox{4.27098pt}{4.40999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.7pt}{\resizebox{3.57098pt}{3.15pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\right.\\
\left.+\left({\mathsf{p}}\frac{2{\mathsf{p}}-1}{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\left(\frac{1-e^{-2{\color[rgb]{1,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{1,0,1}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@stroke{0}{1}{0}{0}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@fill{0}{1}{0}{0}\bm{\omega}}t}}{{\color[rgb]{1,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{1,0,1}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@stroke{0}{1}{0}{0}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@fill{0}{1}{0}{0}\bm{\omega}}}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t^{\star}]}\left\|F^{\mathchoice{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\displaystyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-1.4pt}{\resizebox{5.91821pt}{6.29999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.75pt}{$\textstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.98pt}{\resizebox{4.27098pt}{4.40999pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{1.22499pt}{$\scriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}{\raisebox{-0.7pt}{\resizebox{3.57098pt}{3.15pt}{\hbox{\raisebox{0.875pt}{$\scriptscriptstyle\parallel$}}}}}}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\right)^{2},

for all
(t,{\mathsf{p}})\in[0,t^{\star}]\times\mathbb{N}_{\geq 1}
.
Then, bounding
e^{2\lambda t}-1
by
e^{2\lambda t}
, and
1-e^{-{\color[rgb]{1,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{1,0,1}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@stroke{0}{1}{0}{0}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@fill{0}{1}{0}{0}\bm{\omega}}t}
and
1-e^{-2{\color[rgb]{1,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{1,0,1}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@stroke{0}{1}{0}{0}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@fill{0}{1}{0}{0}\bm{\omega}}t}
by
1
produces desired result in (
C.35
).

∎

The next lemma establishes the bound on
\Xi^{r}
.

Lemma C.1

If the stopping time
\tau^{\star}
, defined in (
34
), Lemma
4.1
, satisfies
\tau^{\star}=t^{\star}
, then

\displaystyle\mathbb{E}_{y_{0}}\left[e^{-2\lambda t}\Xi^{r}\left(t,Y_{N}\right)\right]\leq\frac{\Delta_{\Xi_{1}}^{r}(1,t^{\star})}{2\lambda},\quad\forall t\in[0,t^{\star}],

(C.41a)

\displaystyle\left\|e^{-2\lambda t}\Xi^{r}\left(t,Y_{N}\right)\right\|_{L_{\mathsf{p}}}^{y_{0}}\leq\frac{\Delta_{\Xi_{1}}^{r}({\mathsf{p}},t^{\star})}{2\lambda}+\frac{\Delta_{\Xi_{2}}^{r}({\mathsf{p}},t^{\star})}{2\sqrt{\lambda}},\quad\forall(t,{\mathsf{p}})\in[0,t^{\star}]\times\mathbb{N}_{\geq 2},

(C.41b)

where the term
\Xi^{r}\left(\tau(t),Y_{N}\right)
is defined in (
38
), Lemma
4.1
, and
\Delta_{\Xi_{1}}^{r}({\mathsf{p}},t^{\star})
and
\Delta_{\Xi_{2}}^{r}({\mathsf{p}},t^{\star})
are defined for
{\mathsf{p}}\in\mathbb{N}_{\geq 1}
as follows:

\displaystyle\begin{multlined}\Delta_{\Xi_{1}}^{r}({\mathsf{p}},t^{\star})=\sup_{\nu\in[0,t^{\star}]}\left(\Delta_{g}^{\perp}\left\|\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\left\|\Lambda_{\mu}^{\perp}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\right.\\
\left.+\mathbb{E}_{y_{0}}\left[F_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)^{2{\mathsf{p}}}\right]^{\frac{1}{{\mathsf{p}}}}+\mathbb{E}_{y_{0}}\left[\bar{F}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{\star}_{N,\nu}\right)^{2{\mathsf{p}}}\right]^{\frac{1}{{\mathsf{p}}}}\right),\end{multlined}\Delta_{\Xi_{1}}^{r}({\mathsf{p}},t^{\star})=\sup_{\nu\in[0,t^{\star}]}\left(\Delta_{g}^{\perp}\left\|\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\left\|\Lambda_{\mu}^{\perp}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\right.\\
\left.+\mathbb{E}_{y_{0}}\left[F_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)^{2{\mathsf{p}}}\right]^{\frac{1}{{\mathsf{p}}}}+\mathbb{E}_{y_{0}}\left[\bar{F}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{\star}_{N,\nu}\right)^{2{\mathsf{p}}}\right]^{\frac{1}{{\mathsf{p}}}}\right),

\displaystyle\Delta_{\Xi_{2}}^{r}({\mathsf{p}},t^{\star})=\mathfrak{p}({\mathsf{p}})\sup_{\nu\in[0,t^{\star}]}\left(\Delta_{g}^{\perp}\left\|F^{\perp}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}+\left\|\bar{F}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{\star}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\right)\sup_{\nu\in[0,t^{\star}]}\left\|\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}},

where the constant
\mathfrak{p}({\mathsf{p}})
is defined in (
A.1a
).

Proof.

We begin with the definition of
\Xi^{r}
in (
38
) to write

e^{-2\lambda t}\Xi^{r}\left(t,Y_{N}\right)=e^{-2\lambda t}\int_{0}^{t}e^{2\lambda\nu}\phi^{r}_{\mu}\left(\nu,Y_{N,\nu}\right)d\nu\\
+e^{-2\lambda t}\int_{0}^{t}e^{2\lambda\nu}\begin{bmatrix}\phi^{r}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,Y_{N,\nu}\right)&\phi^{r}_{\sigma_{\star}}\left(\nu,Y_{N,\nu}\right)\end{bmatrix}d\widehat{W}_{\nu},\quad t\in[0,t^{\star}],

(C.42)

where
\widehat{W}_{\nu}\in\mathbb{R}^{2d}
is defined in Definition
5
.
The regularity assumptions and the
t
-continuity of the strong solutions
X^{r}_{N,t}
and
X^{\star}_{N,t}
imply that
\begin{bmatrix}\phi^{r}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,Y_{N,\nu}\right)&\phi^{r}_{\sigma_{\star}}\left(\nu,Y_{N,\nu}\right)\end{bmatrix}\in\mathcal{M}^{loc}_{2}\left(\mathbb{R}^{1\times 2d}|\mathfrak{W}_{t}\times\mathfrak{W}^{\star}_{t}\right)
.
Hence, taking the expectation of (
C.42
) and using the linearity of the expectation operator, along with
[
91
, Thm. 1.5.21]
, leads to

\displaystyle\mathbb{E}_{y_{0}}\left[e^{-2\lambda t}\Xi^{r}\left(t,Y_{N}\right)\right]=

\displaystyle e^{-2\lambda t}\mathbb{E}_{y_{0}}\left[\int_{0}^{t}e^{2\lambda\nu}\phi^{r}_{\mu}\left(\nu,Y_{N,\nu}\right)d\nu\right]

\displaystyle\leq

\displaystyle e^{-2\lambda t}\mathbb{E}_{y_{0}}\left[\int_{0}^{t}e^{2\lambda\nu}\left|\phi^{r}_{\mu}\left(\nu,Y_{N,\nu}\right)\right|d\nu\right],\quad t\in[0,t^{\star}].

(C.43)

In the above, we have used the fact that since
\tau^{\star}=t^{\star}
, and
t^{\star}
is a constant,

\displaystyle\mathbb{E}\left[e^{-2\lambda t}\right]=e^{-2\lambda t},\,\forall t\in[0,t^{\star}].

Moreover, (
C.42
) and the Minkowski’s inequality imply that

\left\|e^{-2\lambda t}\Xi^{r}\left(t,Y_{N}\right)\right\|_{L_{\mathsf{p}}}^{y_{0}}\leq e^{-2\lambda t}\left\|\int_{0}^{t}e^{2\lambda\nu}\left|\phi^{r}_{\mu}\left(\nu,Y_{N,\nu}\right)\right|d\nu\right\|_{L_{\mathsf{p}}}^{y_{0}}\\
+e^{-2\lambda t}\left\|\int_{0}^{t}e^{2\lambda\nu}\begin{bmatrix}\phi^{r}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,Y_{N,\nu}\right)&\phi^{r}_{\sigma_{\star}}\left(\nu,Y_{N,\nu}\right)\end{bmatrix}d\widehat{W}_{\nu}\right\|_{L_{\mathsf{p}}}^{y_{0}},

(C.44)

for all
(t,{\mathsf{p}})\in[0,t^{\star}]\times\mathbb{N}_{\geq 2}
.

Now, the regularity assumptions and the
t
-continuity of the strong solutions
X^{r}_{N,t}
and
X^{\star}_{N,t}
over
[0,t^{\star}]\subseteq[0,\tau_{N}]
imply that
\phi^{r}_{\mu}\left(\nu,Y_{N,\nu}\right)\in\mathcal{M}^{loc}_{2}\left(\mathbb{R}|\mathfrak{W}_{t}\times\mathfrak{W}^{\star}_{t}\right)
.
Thus, we invoke Proposition
B.1
for
\left\{\theta,\xi,n_{s},S\right\}=\left\{2\lambda,0,1,\phi^{r}_{\mu}\left(\cdot,Y_{N}\right)\right\}
to obtain

\displaystyle\left\|\int_{0}^{t}e^{2\lambda\nu}\left|\phi^{r}_{\mu}\left(\nu,Y_{N,\nu}\right)\right|d\nu\right\|_{L_{\mathsf{p}}}^{y_{0}}\leq

\displaystyle\frac{e^{2\lambda t}}{2\lambda}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t]}\left\|\phi^{r}_{\mu}\left(\nu,Y_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{\mathsf{p}}}^{y_{0}}\leq\frac{e^{2\lambda t}}{2\lambda}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t^{\star}]}\left\|\phi^{r}_{\mu}\left(\nu,Y_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{\mathsf{p}}}^{y_{0}},

(C.45)

for all
(t,{\mathsf{p}})\in[0,t^{\star}]\times\mathbb{N}_{\geq 1}
, where we have bounded
e^{2\lambda t}-1
by
e^{2\lambda t}
.
Now, we obtain the following from the definition of
\phi^{r}_{\mu}
in (
39
):

\displaystyle\left|\phi^{r}_{\mu}\left(\nu,Y_{N,\nu}\right)\right|\leq

\displaystyle\left\|\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|\left\|g(\nu)^{\perp}\right\|_{F}\left\|\Lambda_{\mu}^{\perp}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|+\left\|F_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{F}^{2}+\left\|\bar{F}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{\star}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{F}^{2}

\displaystyle\leq

\displaystyle\Delta_{g}^{\perp}\left\|\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|\left\|\Lambda_{\mu}^{\perp}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|+\left\|F_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{F}^{2}+\left\|\bar{F}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{\star}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{F}^{2},

where we have used the bound on
g(t)^{\perp}
from Assumption
1
.
Using the Minkowski’s inequality followed by the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality, we obtain

\left\|\phi^{r}_{\mu}\left(t,Y_{N,t}\right)\right\|_{L_{\mathsf{p}}}^{y_{0}}\leq\Delta_{g}^{\perp}\left\|\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,t}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\left\|\Lambda_{\mu}^{\perp}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,t}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\\
+\mathbb{E}_{y_{0}}\left[F_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,t}\right)^{2{\mathsf{p}}}\right]^{\frac{1}{{\mathsf{p}}}}+\mathbb{E}_{y_{0}}\left[\bar{F}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{\star}_{N,t}\right)^{2{\mathsf{p}}}\right]^{\frac{1}{{\mathsf{p}}}},\quad\forall(t,{\mathsf{p}})\in[0,t^{\star}]\times\mathbb{N}_{\geq 1}.

Substituting the above bound into (
C.45
) produces

\left\|\int_{0}^{t}e^{2\lambda\nu}\left|\phi^{r}_{\mu}\left(\nu,Y_{N,\nu}\right)\right|d\nu\right\|_{L_{\mathsf{p}}}^{y_{0}}\leq\frac{e^{2\lambda t}}{2\lambda}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t^{\star}]}\left(\Delta_{g}^{\perp}\left\|\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\left\|\Lambda_{\mu}^{\perp}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\right.\\
\left.+\mathbb{E}_{y_{0}}\left[F_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)^{2{\mathsf{p}}}\right]^{\frac{1}{{\mathsf{p}}}}+\mathbb{E}_{y_{0}}\left[\bar{F}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{\star}_{N,\nu}\right)^{2{\mathsf{p}}}\right]^{\frac{1}{{\mathsf{p}}}}\right),

(C.46)

for all
(t,{\mathsf{p}})\in[0,t^{\star}]\times\mathbb{N}_{\geq 1}
.
Next, using the definitions of
\phi^{r}_{\sigma_{\star}}
and
\phi^{r}_{\sigma}
in (
39
), we obtain

\int_{0}^{t}e^{2\lambda\nu}\begin{bmatrix}\phi^{r}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,Y_{N,\nu}\right)&\phi^{r}_{\sigma_{\star}}\left(\nu,Y_{N,\nu}\right)\end{bmatrix}d\widehat{W}_{\nu}\\
=\int_{0}^{t}e^{2\lambda\nu}\begin{bmatrix}\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\nu}\right)^{\top}g(\nu)^{\perp}F^{\perp}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\color[rgb]{.75,.5,.25}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{.75,.5,.25}\nu}\right)&-\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\nu}\right)^{\top}\bar{F}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{\star}_{N,\nu}\right)\end{bmatrix}d\widehat{W}_{\nu},

where
\widehat{W}_{\nu}\in\mathbb{R}^{2d}
is defined in Definition
5
.
Recall from the discussion after (
C.42
) that
\begin{bmatrix}\phi^{r}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,Y_{N,\nu}\right)&\phi^{r}_{\sigma_{\star}}\left(\nu,Y_{N,\nu}\right)\end{bmatrix}\in\mathcal{M}^{loc}_{2}\left(\mathbb{R}^{1\times 2d}|\mathfrak{W}_{t}\times\mathfrak{W}^{\star}_{t}\right)
.
Thus, we may use Lemma
B.2
with
\left\{\theta,\xi,n_{l},n_{q},Q\right\}=\left\{2\lambda,0,1,2d,\widehat{W}\right\}
, and

\displaystyle L(t)=\begin{bmatrix}\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,t}\right)^{\top}g(t)^{\perp}F^{\perp}_{\sigma}\left(t,X^{r}_{N,t}\right)&-\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,t}\right)^{\top}\bar{F}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{\star}_{N,t}\right)\end{bmatrix},

to obtain

\left\|\int_{0}^{t}e^{2\lambda\nu}\begin{bmatrix}\phi^{r}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,Y_{N,\nu}\right)&\phi^{r}_{\sigma_{\star}}\left(\nu,Y_{N,\nu}\right)\end{bmatrix}d\widehat{W}_{\nu}\right\|_{L_{\mathsf{p}}}^{y_{0}}\\
\leq\left({\mathsf{p}}\frac{{\mathsf{p}}-1}{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\frac{e^{2\lambda t}}{2\sqrt{\lambda}}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t]}\left\|\begin{bmatrix}\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\nu}\right)^{\top}g(t)^{\perp}F^{\perp}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)&-\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\nu}\right)^{\top}\bar{F}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{\star}_{N,\nu}\right)\end{bmatrix}\right\|_{L_{{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\\
\leq\left({\mathsf{p}}\frac{{\mathsf{p}}-1}{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\frac{e^{2\lambda t}}{2\sqrt{\lambda}}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t^{\star}]}\left\|\begin{bmatrix}\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\nu}\right)^{\top}g(t)^{\perp}F^{\perp}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)&-\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\nu}\right)^{\top}\bar{F}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{\star}_{N,\nu}\right)\end{bmatrix}\right\|_{L_{{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}},

(C.47)

for all
(t,{\mathsf{p}})\in[0,t^{\star}]\times\mathbb{N}_{\geq 2}
, where we have bounded
\left(e^{4\lambda t}-1\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}
by
e^{2\lambda t}
.
Next, observe that

\left\|\begin{bmatrix}\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,t}\right)^{\top}g(t)^{\perp}F^{\perp}_{\sigma}\left(t,X^{r}_{N,t}\right)&-\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,t}\right)^{\top}\bar{F}_{\sigma}\left(t,X^{\star}_{N,t}\right)\end{bmatrix}\right\|\\
=\left(\left\|\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,t}\right)^{\top}g(t)^{\perp}F^{\perp}_{\sigma}\left(t,X^{r}_{N,t}\right)\right\|^{2}+\left\|\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,t}\right)^{\top}\bar{F}_{\sigma}\left(t,X^{\star}_{N,t}\right)\right\|^{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\\
\leq\left(\left\|\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,t}\right)^{\top}g(t)^{\perp}F^{\perp}_{\sigma}\left(t,X^{r}_{N,t}\right)\right\|+\left\|\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,t}\right)^{\top}\bar{F}_{\sigma}\left(t,X^{\star}_{N,t}\right)\right\|\right),

and thus, an application of the Minkowski’s inequality yields

\left\|\begin{bmatrix}\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,t}\right)^{\top}g(t)^{\perp}F^{\perp}_{\sigma}\left(t,X^{r}_{N,t}\right)&-\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,t}\right)^{\top}\bar{F}_{\sigma}\left(t,X^{\star}_{N,t}\right)\end{bmatrix}\right\|_{L_{{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\\
\leq\left(\left\|\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,t}\right)^{\top}g(t)^{\perp}F^{\perp}_{\sigma}\left(t,X^{r}_{N,t}\right)\right\|_{L_{{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}+\left\|\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,t}\right)^{\top}\bar{F}_{\sigma}\left(t,X^{\star}_{N,t}\right)\right\|_{L_{{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\right)\\
\leq\left(\Delta_{g}^{\perp}\left\|\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,t}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\left\|F^{\perp}_{\sigma}\left(t,X^{r}_{N,t}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}+\left\|\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,t}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\left\|\bar{F}_{\sigma}\left(t,X^{\star}_{N,t}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\right),

where we have used the bound on
g(t)^{\perp}
from Assumption
1
, and the Cauchy-Schwarz inequality to obtain the last bound.
Substituting the above bound into (
C.47
) produces

\left\|\int_{0}^{t}e^{2\lambda\nu}\begin{bmatrix}\phi^{r}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,Y_{N,\nu}\right)&\phi^{r}_{\sigma_{\star}}\left(\nu,Y_{N,\nu}\right)\end{bmatrix}d\widehat{W}_{\nu}\right\|_{L_{\mathsf{p}}}^{y_{0}}\\
\leq\left({\mathsf{p}}\frac{{\mathsf{p}}-1}{2}\right)^{\frac{1}{2}}\frac{e^{2\lambda t}}{2\sqrt{\lambda}}\sup_{\nu\in[0,t^{\star}]}\left(\Delta_{g}^{\perp}\left\|\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\left\|F^{\perp}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{r}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\right.\\
\left.+\left\|\partial\mathcal{V}\left(Y_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\left\|\bar{F}_{\sigma}\left(\nu,X^{\star}_{N,\nu}\right)\right\|_{L_{2{\mathsf{p}}}}^{y_{0}}\right),

(C.48)

for all
(t,{\mathsf{p}})\in[0,t^{\star}]\times\mathbb{N}_{\geq 2}
.
Substituting (
C.46
) into (
C
) leads to (
C.41a
), and substituting (
C.46
) and (
C.48
) into (
C.44
) leads to (
C.41b
), thus completing the proof.

∎

We next derive the bound on
\Xi^{r}_{\mathcal{U}}
in the following lemma.

Lemma C.2

If the stopping time
\tau^{\star}
, defined in (
34
), Lemma
4.1
, satisfies
\tau^{\star}=t^{\star}
, then the term
\Xi^{r}_{\mathcal{U}}\left(\tau(t),Y_{N};{\color[rgb]{1,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{1,0,1}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@stroke{0}{1}{0}{0}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@fill{0}{1}{0}{0}\bm{\omega}}\right)
defined in (
38
), Lemma
4.1

where we have used

Hence, exploiting the linearity of the expectation operator, along with Minkowski’s inequality, we obtain

\begin{aligned} &\mathbb{E}_{y_{0}}\left[e^{-(2\lambda+{\color[rgb]{1,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{1,0,1}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@stroke{0}{1}{0}{0}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@fill{0}{1}{0}{0}\bm{\omega}})\tau(t)}\Xi^{r}_{\mathcal{U}}\left(\tau(t),Y_{N};{\color[rgb]{1,0,1}\definecolor[named]{pgfstrokecolor}{rgb}{1,0,1}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@stroke{0}{1}{0}{0}\pgfsys@color@cmyk@fill{0}{1}{0}{0}\bm{\omega}}\right)\right]\\
